New Chapter Technology LLC ("New Chapter") is a technology company in Pinedale, Wyoming, USA that builds its own products, starting with LangX, and partners with teams on AI solutions, AI training, technology consulting and security.

## Chapter I — Products

### LangX (live)

"Practice, learn, succeed."

Our first chapter: a language exchange app that pairs learners with native speakers for real conversations — with voice messages, smart partner filters and an AI Language Copilot. Free, and 100% open source.

- Website and web app: https://langx.io
- iOS (App Store): https://apps.apple.com/us/app/langx-practice-learn-succeed/id6474187141
- Android (Google Play): https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=tech.newchapter.languageXchange

### Forthcoming

- In development: a new product is on the way — announcing soon.
- In planning: the next chapter is already being drafted.

---

## Chapters II–III — Services

What we can write together.

1. **AI Solutions** — Custom assistants, automations and models trained on your data — designed around your real workflows.
2. **AI Training** — Workshops and programs that take whole teams from curious to confident, using tasks from your own work.
3. **Personalized AI Training** — One-to-one learning paths built around a single person's role, tools and goals — from founders to engineers.
4. **Technology Consulting** — Architecture, roadmaps and build-vs-buy decisions from a team that ships its own products.
5. **Security** — Audits, hardening and secure-by-design practices for apps, cloud infrastructure and AI systems.
6. **App & Web Development** — iOS, Android and web products, from the first prototype to launch day and every release after.
